question: Marathi language is in the _______ language family.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indo Aryan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Marathi** belongs to the **Indo Aryan** language family.
 
• It is one of the **22 scheduled languages** of India and the official language of the state of Maharashtra.
